_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: downside stress (ETF flows, skew, crowded longs) is offset by fed liquidity and intact 200w trend, so score is expected to stay inside the current band unless a named breaker hits.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase call (commodity pipe rotation only)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55 and 30d momentum stays inside roughly -8% to +5% while ETF flows remain dead-to-flat
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows and CVD turn up together with F&G through 60 (up into Disbelief) or price breaks down with F&G under 40 while skew stays extreme (down into deeper Anxiety)
